Name: Hallway Fix (plus Other Misc. Additions)
Author: KaliRivera
Description:
[b][color=#ff0000]UPDATE 1.3[/color]:[/b] ALL listed map mod compatibilities are now included in Hallway Fix, thanks to the new [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284?tab=description]Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens[/url] by Spiderbuttons giving me the ability to directly attach parts of my mods to the config settings of other mods. No more switching between two different mods' configs to change a few simple settings![i] Wooo![/i] And speaking of compatibility... Now that Hallway Fix is inherently compatible with [color=#ffd966]T's Apartment House[/color], the Bonus Room added in Hallway Fix can now be used with that mod! 

[color=#00ffff]If you downloaded the previous optional patches for T's Apartment House or Aimon's Tidy Cozy FarmHouse, I'd still recommend downloading the latest version of Hallway Fix: on top of removing the need for optional files by adding compatibility into Hallway Fix directly, I've also optimized the Hallway Fix patches for those mods, so they should work even better now! It also doesn't matter whether you already installed the old optional files or not; the new and improved patches included in Hallway Fix will replace them automatically![/color]

I've always been a little annoyed with how wallpapers would never fully cover the little "hallways" between rooms, and I couldn't find a mod that offered the kind of fix I was looking for, so I decided to make it.

There are two variants included, [color=#ffd966]With Bottom Trim[/color] and [color=#ffd966]Without Bottom Trim[/color]. You can also set the hallways to the default appearance if you'd like(you'll still be able to hang wall decor from them). [color=#ffd966]See images for reference.[/color] You can switch between variants in the config.json or the Generic Mod Config menu.

Yeah, this mod fixes the hallways, [i]but[/i] I've had a [i]little [/i]too much free time on my hands lately, so this mod also adds a few various optional additions that can be toggled in the config menu, to hopefully make up for the [i]very[/i] limited compatibility with other Farmhouse map mods.

[color=#ffff00][size=3]The additions include:[/size][/color]
-Allows wall decor to be hung not only on the hallways, but also the[color=#ffff00] Spouse Room[/color], [color=#ffff00]Southern Room[/color], and [color=#ffff00]Ginger Island Farmhouse[/color] [color=#ffff00]beams[/color]
-Ability to [color=#ffff00]extend the hallways[/color] to allow for [color=#ffff00]additional walking space[/color] without taking the wall out completely
-[color=#ffff00]The Upper Room can be extended[/color] downward by one tile(see images) so it's level with the Nursery
-[color=#ffff00]A Bonus Room[/color] can be enabled to add a room above the Dining Room, as well as the option to [color=#ffff00]add a hallway connecting the Bonus Room and Upper Room[/color](which can be extended like the other halls)
-[color=#ffff00]Nooks can be added to Southern Room[/color], with the option to add them to the left, right, or both sides, and flooring/wallpaper for them can be done separately from the rest of the Southern Room
-[color=#ffff00]A cellar can be added to the Ginger Island Farmhouse[/color] that can hold up to [color=#ffff00][b]200 casks[/b][/color], and unlike the normal cellar, the [color=#ffff00]flooring and wallpaper can be changed[/color]

[size=3][color=#00ff00]The following mods [/color][b][color=#00ff00]require[/color] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284?tab=description]Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens[/url][b] [/b][color=#00ff00]to work properly with Hallway Fix:[/color][/size]
-Elegant Town Interiors
-Rustic Country Town Interiors
-Starblue Valley
-Custom Spouse Room Locations
-T's Apartment House
-Aimon's Tidy Cozy FarmHouse
-Aimon's Fancy Farmhouse
-Tiny Farmhouse 1.6
-Lune FarmHouse

[color=#00ffff][size=3]Compatible Interior Recolor Mods:[/size]
[/color]-DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors
-Rustic Country Town Interiors (+added a few missing 1.6 textures)
-Elegant Town Interiors (+added a few missing 1.6 textures)
-Vibrant Pastoral Recolor (+added a few missing 1.6 textures)
-Starblue Valley (specifically the unofficial version updated for 1.6)

[color=#00ffff][size=3]Compatible Farmhouse Map Mods:[/size][/color]
-Jen's Storage Cabins
-Custom Spouse Room Locations
-Lnh's First FarmHouse 
-Cozy Nooks Farmhouse
-T's Apartment House
-Aimon's Tidy Cozy Farmhouse
-Aimon's Fancy Farmhouse
-Tiny Farmhouse 1.6
-Lune FarmHouse

[color=#ff0000][b]BEFORE YOU DOWNLOAD[/b][/color]: Please note this mod is [color=#ff0000]not [/color]compatible with [i]most[/i] other mods that alter the [color=#ff0000]farmhouse maps/layout/textures[/color], including any [color=#ff0000]building interior recolors[/color], with exception to those listed as [color=#ffd966]compatible [/color]above. If you encounter any specific incompatibilities, please let me know! I'm always looking to make Hallway Fix more compatible other mods for y'all <3

[color=#ffff00] If I'm currently working on any specific patches, I'll have them listed below![/color]

Manifest.Name: Hallway Fix
